introduction.text: Betelgeuse is close and large enough that the VLT interferometer resolves its disc. Its photosphere is a few huge convection cells that change over months.

sources.label: Drevon et al. 2024
sources.quote: We present images of Betelgeuse obtained with the VLTI/MATISSE instrument at three epochs

matisse.title: Photosphere at 4 µm
matisse.summary: Rebuilt from four telescopes' fringes; colour is infrared brightness. Its patches are unconfirmed and may be artefacts.

dust-2024.title: Polarised dust, 2024
dust-2024.summary: Dust one to four stellar radii out, in the paper's own colour scale. Its depth is a convention, not a measurement.

dust-2019.summary: The dust that dimmed the southern half ten times, as Montargès and colleagues fitted it. A model, not an image.
